record.scope: One fixed diagnostic execution, both F0 and F1 mandatory, no coefficient selection or export, no fits or provider launches; R1 failed before data values.

estimand.alpha0_1_derivative: Compute the real-arithmetic right derivative at p + 0.1 * (q_j - p); do not project at alpha 0.1.

alpha0_projection.F0_projection: A receives calibration-only projection; B/C receive calibration-only and calibration-plus-common-A projections.
alpha0_projection.F1_projection: A receives a separate calibration-only projection using its own F1 parent and membership.
alpha0_projection.candidate_direction: q_j - p, passed through the right derivative of clip(p, -2, 2).
alpha0_projection.common_A_direction: A - p, passed through the same right derivative at p.
alpha0_projection.gram_rank: Drop numerical-zero nuisance variances; standardize positive-variance columns to unit weighted variance; retain eigenvalues strictly above lambda_max * 1e-10 in the weighted correlation Gram. Report full spectrum, rank, orthogonality, projected norm share, and materially negative eigenvalues.
alpha0_projection.regular_branch_only: Score decomposition is omitted on an official score gate or final-correlation kink; the directional derivative and gate status remain reported.
alpha0_projection.shared_base: For every candidate in a fold, use its own source-pinned raw parent p as the common base.

estimand.component_statistics: Save, per endpoint/component/target, additive total weights, every weighted first moment and the full row-major weighted cross-product matrix. Also save stable centered per-component moments for covariance and bootstrap recomputation.
estimand.no_selection: No target-based alpha choice, coefficient search/export, endpoint selection, or public-score forecast. Evaluation-weighted projection coefficients are descriptive only.

official_metric.target_handling: Compute derivatives and covariances separately for target 0 and target 1; average the two score derivatives only after each target's own weights and score branch are applied.

exposure.F0: Exposed fold 0, seed 1001 development evidence; fixed endpoints and shrink grades already used the same evaluation rows.
exposure.F1: Exposed fold 1, seed 1002 post-F0-designed follow-up; its fixed endpoint grade already used the same evaluation rows.
exposure.claim: Conditional diagnostic uncertainty only; neither fold is a fresh holdout or clean confirmation.

interpretation_limits: F0 and F1 evaluations are exposed development evidence and were already used to grade these exact endpoints.
Bootstrap intervals condition on fitted endpoints, evaluated membership, and prior endpoint selection; they omit training, fold, exposure, selection, and transfer uncertainty.
A projection or derivative is a geometry diagnostic, not a causal training explanation, realizable clipped counterfactual, deployable calibrator, or public-score forecast.
A positive derivative at alpha 0 is not an observed fixed-alpha score gain; the fixed alpha 0.1 endpoint is scored and compared separately.
The historical twelve-fit panel remains incomplete; this zero-fit analysis does not complete it or establish clean cross-validation.

metric.row_mask: original official mask and row index >= 99

moment_artifact.storage: complete per-component weighted first moments and full cross-product matrices

moment_table_schema.target_axis: two target-specific tables; average score gradients only after calculation
